I added a log line to `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py` that records the invoice id:

```python
log.info("invoice_refunded", invoice_id=invoice.id)
```

The project uses `structlog` rather than Python's built-in `logging`, so I set up the logger the same way `src/billing/invoices.py` does. The event name is in snake_case like the existing `invoice_finalized` event. The line runs after the amount check passes, so only valid refunds get logged. I haven't run any tests.

If you also want the amount in the log, I can add `refunded_cents=amount_cents` to the same line.
